notes.title: Halloween update 1.3.5
notes.notes: [b]The Halloween update is now available in Neko Journey, a new menu theme has been added, as well as 1 new halloween themed level. You can find it in the menu by clicking: game/halloween level. The menu view can be switched by clicking on the pumpkin icon. Minor bugs fixed[/b]

notes.title: Patch v1.3.4
notes.notes:
[b]Minor fixes on the levels
On levels where you need to run to the left, there is now more vision
Flashlight character removed
Fix widgets, update appearance
Added new pets to the shop, in the village
Fixed collision of some enemies[/b]

notes.title: Patch_Fix_2
notes.notes:
[b]The game will now pause when minimizing
Fixes for some cutscenes
Minor fixes[/b]

notes.title: Patch v1.3.3
notes.notes:
[b]Fixed Roguelike mod
Fixed fast game now the level is shown properly
Weakened the damage of all normal enemies
Big orcs can now jump on their heads at the first levels
Fix collisions on levels[/b]

notes.title: Patch 1-3-2
notes.notes:
[b]Text typing speed is now faster in dialogs
Lowered the walls in the castle, obstructed the view
Added additional checkpoints on the surface
Some enemies are weakened
Fix some widgets, stuck on the screen
The character now often cuts somersaults
In Speed Events, the character no longer rolls[/b]

notes.title: Neko Journey v1.3
notes.notes:
[b]Corrected the text
Bosses should no longer break
Miscellaneous fixes[/b]

notes.title: Patch 1_2
notes.notes:
Changelist:

[olist]
[*] Fixed somersault bug of the main character
[*] Bosses attack damage was reduced by 50%
[*] Advices on how to beat the bosses are now free!
[*] A "restart" button has been added to the menu when you fight the boss (in case he bugs)
[*] Enemies of level 4_1 fixed, now they can walk
[*] The restart button of the pause menu is now highlighted in red
[*] Enemies can't attack you, while you in a dialogue with a character
[*] Red arrow on the top of the characters with interaction
[*] Minor edits
[/olist]

notes.title: Bugs or issues with Neko Journey
notes.notes: [b]If you have any bugs or any problems with the game, then write to the community center in the discussion :)[/b]
